comments.author: @contents.003
comments.text:
Does anyone here even know how much blood this land carries beneath its beauty?

It is a place that holds a largely hidden history of the genocide and suffering of Tamils, a history that remains largely unknown to the outside world. Our Tamil people, who had lived there as natives for thousands of years, were subjected to massacres, persecution, and immense suffering.

Tamils of every age—men and women, young girls and boys, infants, schoolchildren, and the elderly—were among those who endured torture, sexual violence, killings, and other grave abuses. 

Countless Tamil lives were lost, including innocent infants and schoolchildren, with many victims never receiving a proper burial or recognition. There have also been deeply disturbing accounts of Tamil women being subjected to horrific forms of sexual violence and mutilation by members of the security forces. These atrocities have left generations carrying the scars of what happened.

Lakhs of our people lost their lives during this period, and many families were left searching for answers about their loved ones. Even today, we still have not received justice.

To everyone who enjoys the beauty of Sri Lanka, please take a moment to learn about this history too. ❤️‍🩹

@4k Films by Adnan Thank you for sharing this incredible journey through Sri Lanka! The stunning 4K footage of places like Sigiriya Rock Fortress, the tea plantations of Nuwara Eliya, Nine Arch Bridge, and the beautiful beaches was absolutely breathtaking. A truly beautiful film that makes me want to explore Sri Lanka someday!

Hello! It’s already the second half of September here in Japan. It has become quite cool, although we may still have typhoons and some lingering summer heat.
